category: 外部信息-真实网页-系统与数据

files.bin/launch.sh:
#!/bin/sh
docker run -d --name quay-index --restart always redis:7
docker run -d --name quay-cache --restart unless-stopped redis:7
docker run -d --name quay-export --restart on-failure:4 alpine:3.20 sleep 600
files.ops/stops.csv:
container,stop_method
quay-index,docker stop
quay-cache,docker stop
quay-export,docker stop
files.notes/reboot.md:
# Daemon maintenance

All three containers were up for more than 10 seconds before the manual stops in ops/stops.csv. The Docker daemon will restart next. No container is manually started afterward.

turns.prompt: First open this page before reading the local files: https://docs.docker.com/engine/containers/start-containers-automatically.md . Using bin/launch.sh, ops/stops.csv and notes/reboot.md, which single container will Docker restart automatically when the daemon restarts? Give the container name. Do not run commands or change files.
